events.body:
At the start of the week, queue a few social posts across your connected channels. After they publish, return to see how each post performed.

Buffer is social media management software that brings this weekly planning and review loop into one dashboard. Your queue holds upcoming posts, while Insights sits alongside the content it measures.

In Insights, you can inspect recent engagement, impressions, and post performance without turning the check into a larger reporting exercise.

The Free plan supports up to three connected channels, with no more than 10 scheduled posts per channel at one time and 30 days of Insights history.

See Buffer’s official plans to check whether those boundaries fit your week.
